answer.instructions: Sort this email that arrived in a personal inbox.

criteria.phishing: Pretends to be a trusted company or person to steal a password, a payment or personal details
criteria.spam: Unwanted bulk advertising or promotion that is not trying to steal anything
criteria.safe: A genuine email the reader expects or wants, such as a receipt, a note from someone they know or a real account notice
